notes.title: Big update for Spring Festival
notes.notes:
1. Added vehicles. Players can use vehicles in specific maps (levels with outdoor scenes).
2. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Updated in January
notes.notes:
1. The graffiti instructions in the sewer scene at the beginning of the game were improved and changed to night light mode, which allows players to better identify the direction of the exit.
[img]file:///F:/testabc/testabc/Saved/Screenshots/WindowsEditor/HighresScreenshot00000.png[/img]
2. Improved the interactive UI. Changed the original square with no hint to a circle with a ring. This will let players know better whether to long press or not.

notes.title: Version update on December 20th
notes.notes:
1. Updated the mapping button of the comprehensive information page UI, changing from the original J to ESC.
2. Added the occlusion effect of characters including the protagonist. When the player plays the character and is in a closer field of view, the transparency effect will be displayed.
3. Modified some collision body issues.
